name: Horacio
source:
Horatio, king of Steinna, is a wise man. After his wife's death, however, he has grown more and more worried about his daughter, whom he wants to protect...

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/the-dragon-princess]Itch.io[/url]]
